<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2TDvuJ2KygqHcBPtkDgePBK)_

Step 4 of 5. **Base: `419-devonthink-design-adrs` (#419)**. Stack: #414 → #415 → #418 → #419 → #420.

## What
- `sp-devonthink-highlights-import` (`C-c k d h`) in a litnote copies the highlights of its PDF under a `* Highlights` heading: one list item each, the text plus a `devonthink:` link to its page (`key p. 6`).
- One way only (DEVONthink to Emacs): it only appends list items under that heading and adds only highlights not already there (whitespace and case ignored), so your edits survive a second run. The buffer is left unsaved.
- `tools/devonthink-highlights.py FILE.pdf` prints the highlights as JSON by page (from 1), reusing the reader of `devonthink-to-litdb.py`; Emacs runs it with `sp-litdb-python`.
- Literate doc `docs/tangles/academic/sp-devonthink-highlights.org`; README row.

## Not tested
- On the Mac: the `path of` AppleScript, and that highlights made in DEVONthink's viewer are standard highlight annotations in the file.
- Tested here: 7 ERT tests, 4 Python tests including a real PDF with a highlight made with PyMuPDF, and the tangle check.

## Manual testing
Mac, fish, `~/.config/emacs-modular`. This edits a litnote buffer (not saved); use a note you can discard changes in.
- [ ] Check out: `cd ~/dotfiles; git fetch origin 420-devonthink-highlights; git checkout 420-devonthink-highlights`, restart Emacs.
- [ ] Elisp tests: `cd ~/.config/emacs-modular; emacs -Q --batch -L libraries/modules/academic -l ert -l tests/sp-devonthink-highlights-test.el -f ert-run-tests-batch-and-exit` → 7 pass. Python: `~/.local/share/uv/tools/litdb/bin/python -m unittest tests/test_devonthink_highlights.py` → 4 pass.
- [ ] Script alone: `~/.local/share/uv/tools/litdb/bin/python tools/devonthink-highlights.py ~/Documents/literature/KEY.pdf` (a PDF with highlights) → JSON like `[{"page": 6, "highlights": ["…"]}]`.
- [ ] In that PDF's litnote: `C-c k d h` → "Added N highlights under Highlights (not saved)"; a `* Highlights` heading at the end with `- text [[devonthink:UUID::6][key p. 6]]` items.
- [ ] `C-c C-o` on a link → DEVONthink opens on that page (report if off by one).
- [ ] Reword one item, run `C-c k d h` again → "No new highlights", your edit untouched. Add a highlight in DEVONthink, run again → only the new one is added.
- [ ] A note whose record has no file on disk → "The record has no file on disk (is it indexed?)"; a PDF without highlights → "No highlights in the PDF".
- [ ] Discard the buffer changes (do not save) or save and check `git diff` in `~/notes` shows only the new section.

comment_regular_data.body:
**Merge order:** merge #437, #415 and #418 first. New commit here: `sp-devonthink-highlights-import` follows `crossref`, after asking (the highlights would be those of the whole parent book, linked to the parent's record).

**Extra manual test:**
- [ ] On the litnote of a chapter with no record of its own, `C-c k d h`: it asks `Import highlights from the record of PARENT (the whole book)?`; `n` imports nothing, `y` adds the parent's highlights with links to the parent's record.

**Revert:** revert the commit "Follow crossref in sp-devonthink-highlights-import".
